subject: general
question: As per the Reserve Bank of India notification of March 2022 the minimum requirement of microfinance loans for NBFC-MFIs should be ______ per cent of the total assets
solution:
The correct answer is __**75**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The RBI regulation mandates that **at least 75%** of the total assets of an NBFC-MFI must be microfinance loans.
 
• **Microfinance loans** are small loans provided to individuals or small businesses, typically those who lack access to traditional banking services.
 
• For households with annual income of** up to ₹3 lakh**, loans are classified as microfinance.
 
• Total loans for households with annual income **under ₹3 lakh** should not exceed **50%** of the household income.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The RBI was established on April 1, 1935, under the **Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934.**
 
• Non-Banking Financial Companies that exclusively deal in microfinance. These are regulated by the RBI.
 
• The RBI sets a cap on how much an MFI can lend to a borrower. For instance, the total indebtedness of a borrower should not exceed **₹1.25 lakh from all sources.**
 
• **MUDRA (Micro Units Development and Refinance Agency) Scheme**: Provides financial support to small businesses through MFIs, NBFCs, and banks.
 
• **Self-Help Group-Bank Linkage Program (SHG-BLP)**: Promoted by NABARD, it links SHGs to banks, enabling them to access formal banking services.
